blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will become a whole day event starting Thursday as the Senate impeachment court expedites the proceedings and gives itself time to for legislative functions. The schedule adjustment comes as the trial of the vice president coincides with the Congress’ deliberations and debates for the 2027 national budget, typically spanning from October to November. Starting Thursday, the impeachment trial will be held from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. every Monday to Friday until Oct. 15 – after which the court will temporarily suspend the proceedings in lieu of budget talks.
